name: [R31] Server/production host connects to a cryptocurrency exchange API
message:
Exploratory heuristic for the "cryptocurrency exchange access" tooling Hunt.io found on attacker infrastructure tied to a campaign against seven South Korean banks (2026-11-04). Hunt.io said this tooling's relation to that specific campaign is unconfirmed -- this rule targets the general technique (a compromised server, not a user's own trading client, reaching an exchange API), a common later-stage monetization step after a breach.

Tune: allowlist any legitimate backend integration your own product has with a crypto exchange before relying on this. The exchange hostname list is illustrative, not exhaustive.

queries.name: server_crypto_api_egress
queries.query: source:proxy @src.zone:(server OR production OR backend) @destination.hostname:(*api.binance.* OR *api.coinbase.* OR *api.kraken.* OR *api.upbit.* OR *api.bithumb.* OR *api.okx.* OR *api.bybit.*)

cases.name: Server-zone host reached a cryptocurrency exchange API
